text: りゅうじん　さまの　ほねを　おがめる　とは！

structure.jp: りゅうじん　さまの　ほねを
structure.en: the bones of the Dragon God
to think I can behold them!

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは at the end of a sentence shows surprise, like 'to think that...!'. おがめる　とは = 'to think I can behold them!'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing おがむ to おがめる turns 'behold' into 'can behold'. おがめる = 'can behold'.
